snippet.title: BOINGBOUND — Animals on Springs | Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist BOINGBOUND on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5425400/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=boingbound_announcement&utm_content=trailer

There are lots of ways to describe the fun in this game, but the fact that the animals sit in springs probably says enough.

BOINGBOUND is a challenging 3D climbing platformer. Hold to charge, aim your jump and release to launch yourself from the forest towards the stars. Once you are airborne, there is no steering your way out of a bad decision.

Miss a landing, and you might get a much closer look at the places you’ve already climbed.

The Steam page is now live. Wishlist BOINGBOUND to follow its journey to release.

https://discord.gg/DNc5XJUyS
